english.text: On a crowded platform not too far from Natalia's spot, a Chinese man can be seen playing a traditional Chinese instrument, the erhu. His music is constantly interrupted by the roar of passing trains, or the blare of the public announcement system. Few people stop to listen to him, but those who do listen are rewarded, both by the music and by the smile of welcome on the musician's face.

jyutping: hai2 lei4 Natalia go3 wai2 m4 taai3 jyun5 ge3 zai1 mun5 jan4 ge3 ping4 toi4 soeng6，ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 zung1 gwok3 naam4 jan2 daan6 gan2 jat1 zung2 zung1 gwok3 cyun4 tung2 ngok6 hei3，zik1 hai6 ji6 wu2。keoi5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 bat1 dyun6 bei6 lou6 gwo3 ge3 fo2 ce1 ge3 haau1 giu3 seng1 daa2 tyun5，waak6 ze2 hai6 gung1 hoi1 gung1 gou3 hai6 tung2 ge3 cou4 zaap6 seng1。hou2 siu2 jan4 wui5 ting4 dai1 teng1 keoi5，daan6 hai6 go2 di1 teng1 ge3 jan4 wui5 dak1 dou3 wui4 bou3，mou4 leon6 hai6 jam1 ngok6 ding6 hai6 jam1 ngok6 gaa1 lim5 soeng6 ge3 fun1 jing4 siu3 jung4。
text: 喺離 Natalia 個位唔太遠嘅擠滿人嘅平台上，可以見到一個中國男人彈緊一種中國傳統樂器，即係二胡。佢嘅音樂不斷被路過嘅火車嘅吼叫聲打斷，或者係公開公告系統嘅嘈雜聲。好少人會停低聽佢，但係嗰啲聽嘅人會得到回報，無論係音樂定係音樂家臉上嘅歡迎笑容。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I do not believe progress is possible if our desire to preserve our identities gives way to an impulse to dehumanize or dominate another group. If our religion leads us to persecute those of another faith, if we jail or beat people who are gay, if our traditions lead us to prevent girls from going to school, if we discriminate on the basis of race or tribe or ethnicity, then the fragile bonds of civilization will fray.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng1 seon3 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 soeng2 bou2 lau4 zi6 gei2 ge3 san1 fan2 ge3 juk6 mong6 ling6 dou3 heoi3 jan4 sing3 faa3 waak6 ze2 baa3 zim3 ling6 jat1 go3 kwan4 tai2 ge3 cung1 dung6，jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zung1 gaau3 ling6 ngo5 dei6 bik1 hoi6 ling6 jat1 go3 seon3 joeng5 ge3 jan4，jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 gaam1 gam3 waak6 ze2 daa2 tung4 sing3 lyun2 ze2，jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 cyun4 tung2 ling6 ngo5 dei6 zo2 zi2 neoi5 zai2 soeng5 hok6 haau6，jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 gei1 jyu1 zung2 zuk6、bou6 lok6 waak6 ze2 zuk6 jeoi6 ji4 kei4 si6，gam3 ceoi3 joek6 ge3 man4 ming4 gwaan1 hai6 zau6 wui6 po3 lit6。
text: 我唔相信如果我哋想保留自己嘅身份嘅慾望令到去人性化或者霸佔另一個群體嘅衝動，如果我哋嘅宗教令我哋迫害另一個信仰嘅人，如果我哋監禁或者打同性戀者，如果我哋嘅傳統令我哋阻止女仔上學校，如果我哋基於種族、部落或者族裔而歧視，咁脆弱嘅文明關係就會破裂。
